newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Doctors remove wrong kidney from Swedish patient.
newsitem.headline: Doctors remove wrong kidney from Swedish patient.

text.p: A Swedish cancer patient came out of a kidney operation feeling fighting fit and expecting a quick recovery -- only to be told the surgeon had removed the wrong kidney.
Jan Johansson, 43, had an operation at Mora Hospital in central Sweden to remove his cancerous left kidney, but was told a week later the surgeon had made a mistake and taken out his right kidney.
"I could have died because of this mistake," Johansson told the tabloid newspaper Expressen.
Doctors in Uppsala, 70 km (45 miles) north of Stockholm, took over Johansson's case and this week removed 70 percent of the affected kidney.
"According to the doctors, with this little bit of kidney I have left, I should be able to lead a normal life," he said.
